title: 百万预测太离谱：散户悄悄回来，机构还在当最后买家吗？
speaker: Haslif Kureshi

segments.en: Could have you with us. Thanks for having me. What happened to the one million? Look, I don't know who's
segments.zh: 欢迎做客。谢谢邀请。那一百万预测怎么了？说实话，我不知道是谁

segments.en: saying one million. I think it's pretty clear that was a very outlandish prediction. But I think
segments.zh: 在说一百万。很明显那是一个非常离谱的预测。但我认为

segments.en: the market is consolidating. Now that some of the craziness has drained out of the AI market,
segments.zh: 市场正在盘整。AI市场的一些狂热已经消退，

segments.zh: 如果你记得今年年初，黄金疯涨，然后存储类标的也疯涨。

segments.en: Now I think retail has started to pick up attention again in crypto. We're seeing trading volumes on
segments.zh: 现在我认为散户开始重新关注加密市场。我们看到交易量在

segments.en: exchanges going up. We're seeing retail indicators of interest starting to increase again.
segments.zh: 交易所上升。我们看到散户兴趣指标开始再次增加。

segments.en: Some of the apps that are in the app store are starting to get a lot of downloads. These are
segments.zh: 应用商店里的一些应用开始获得大量下载。这些是

segments.zh: 散户再次关注加密市场的常规信号。但如果你回到夏天，

segments.en: you go back to like March April, retail interest was at rock bottom in crypto. People kind of forgot
segments.zh: 回到三四月份，散户对加密的兴趣处于谷底。人们几乎忘了

segments.en: this industry and existed. So the retail is difficult. And the time that retail is not here,
segments.zh: 这个行业的存在。所以散户很难。当散户不在的时候，

segments.en: it's on institutions and hedge funds to keep up the demand and really be the last buyer of resort
segments.zh: 就靠机构和对冲基金来维持需求，真正成为最后的买家
